title: Very good experience
text: We booked the ebike tour and cycled for 2 hours through Albaicín and Sacromonte. We are very satisfied with our guide Mario. He took us to beautiful places, viewpoints, 2 caves and told a lot about the history of Granada.
author: daphnen305

title: Excellrnt

title: Great tour
text: Mario, our guide, was super friendly and we had a blast with him. We can only recommend him further.

title: The bike ride
text: It was a spectacular tour, Mario the boy who gave me the tour very professional, took me to see incredible views, he was also a connoisseur of the area, I recommend this tour and the guide Mario, you will not regret
author: jamyp2022

title: The narrow streets of the Albayzin neighborhoods.
text: I loved this bike experience throughout the Albayzin, Mario was an excellent tour guide took me to see beautiful views, and always with an excellent storytelling I recommend this tour. Go and ask Mario you won't regret it. You'll learn a lot.
author: jamyp2022

title: Would highly recommend. Stunning views at the top!
text: Wow we had such a great time! It was a small group of 4 of us. We had one-on-one instruction and the guide was incredibly attentive to our needs. The Segway is safe and such an easy way to go up on the incline of Albaicin quarter. I was concerned about the cobblestone roads but they it wasn't an issue with the Segway at all. Would highly recommend!
author: Susan_E
